name: nginx-networking
description: Engineers nginx as a reverse proxy and API gateway: location routing, headers, rate limiting, and caching layers.

capabilities.name: proxy
capabilities.description: Route and transform traffic with nginx locations.

capabilities.name: gateway
capabilities.description: Apply rate limits, caching, and header policies.

examples.output: Configures the upstream with least_conn and health checks, wires proxy_pass, and verifies with curl -sI and nginx -t.

examples.input: Rate limit the search endpoint to 10 rps.
examples.output: Adds the limit_req_zone and applies burst=20 nodelay, then confirms 429s with ab.
